lines.speaker: Watch Sergeant
lines.text: Floor Nine. Stand down and clear the aisle. You are in breach of the charter's labour terms.

lines.speaker: Jory Slate
lines.text: The floor's still running, Rowen. Nobody shut the tap off. Ask yourself who wants it hot in here.

lines.speaker: Rowen Corvane
lines.text: Then get behind the presses, Jory.

lines.speaker: Jory Slate
lines.text: There's no behind on a press line. There's in front of it and there's in it.

lines.speaker: Provocateur Foreman
lines.text: Hold the aisle. Let them come up under the ladle.

lines.speaker: Provocateur Foreman
lines.text: Tap deck holds the mains. Keep the line hot.

lines.speaker: Jory Slate
lines.text: Nobody on this floor gave that order.

lines.speaker: Jory Slate
lines.text: That's Perren Ash. Thirty years on the pour. He has a wife on Tallow Row and a son in the yard.
